# read2_B — pp. 21–23 (leaves n22–n24): log

Read against witness_B.txt line by line, five print lines per page; witness line breaks match the print on
all three pages (p. 21 and p. 23 open a leaf front with ༄༅༔ ༔). Line-ends: no པའཾ / ལཾ abbreviations on these
pages; lines 21.4, 21.5, 22.5, 23.3 and 23.5 end in filler dots in the print (not transcribed).

Tsheg note: in this print the tsheg is a very small wedge and is often invisible at scan resolution. Witness
tshegs were kept where the letters agree; only places where a tsheg is clearly placed differently or a letter
is fused/missing are logged.

## Interlinear addition (22.3)

The words ངོ་ཤེས་པར་གྱིས་ཤིག are carved small between lines 22.2 and 22.3, above the start of
ཉམས་ལན་གྱི་ཐོག་ཏུ, with an insertion mark after ཡོད་དོ༔. The main line reads ...ཡོད་དོ༔ ཉམས་ལན... .
Following the witness, the addition is written inline at its insertion point. The drafter may want to note it.

## Suspected misprints (print kept in read2_B.txt)

- 21.4 ནམཁའི → ནམ་མཁའི. Certain as to sense. It is the common contraction/haplography (one མ for two). A `# fix:`
  candidate if contractions are written out.
- 22.5 མཚན་མཁ་དོག → མཚན་མ་ཁ་དོག ("marks and colour"). The tsheg is missing between མ and ཁ (×9: none visible, while
  the tsheg after མཚན is visible). Certain. Other recension: མཚན་མ་ཁ་དོག.
- 22.3 ཉམས་ལན → ཉམས་ལེན. Likely (only if no ེ is hidden, see [?]). It is spelt ཉམས་ལེན in 21.5 and 22.1.
- 23.2 སིང་ང → སིང་ངེ (cf. སིང་ངེ 22.5; other recension སང་ངེ). Moderate, see [?].
- 23.5 ཤེས་རིགས་ཀྱི → ཤེས་རིག་གི. Low. The ས is clearly printed and ཀྱི agrees with it. Everywhere else the print has
  ཤེས་རིག, and the other recension has ཤེས་རིག་གི here.

## Other recension: differences of sense

- 22.3 the print has ཁྱེད་རང་ལ ("you", to a senior); the other recension has རང་རེ་ལ ("us", inclusive).
- 23.1 the print has ཁྱོད་རང་གི་ཤེས་རིག་གི་ངོ་བོ་སྟོང་པའོ༔ ("the nature of your awareness is empty"). The other
  recension has ཤེས་རིག་སྟོང་རྡོ་ཙམ་ནས་སྟོང་པ ("empty, but not merely empty like a stone"). The print lacks the stone
  comparison.
- 23.5 print: དེ་ངོ་ཤེས་བྱས་ཆོག་གོ; other: ངོ་ཤེས་པས་ཆོག་གོ (same sense). Print: སྐྱེ་ཤི་མེད་པ; other: སྐྱེ་འཆི་མེད་པས
  (same sense).
- The print agrees with the other recension on ཀུན་ཏུ་བཟང་མོ (23.1). Only the witness had པོ.
